vb10:1.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:2.2: Idha bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatam pi cirabhāsitam pi saritā anussaritā.
vb10:3.1: So tathā-sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya vicinati pavicinati parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjati.
vb10:4.1: Tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya vicinato pavicinato parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ.
vb10:6.1: Pītimanassa kāyo pi passambhati cittaṃ pi passambhati.
vb10:8.1: So tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti.
vb10:9.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:10.2: Atthi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu sati, atthi bahiddhā dhammesu sati.
vb10:10.3: Yadā pi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu sati, tadā pi satisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:10.4: Yadā pi bahiddhā dhammesu sati, tadā pi satisamobojjhaṅgaṃ abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:11.2: Atthi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu pavicayo, atthi bahiddhā dhammesu pavicayo.
vb10:11.3: Yadā pi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu pavicayo, tadā pi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:11.4: Yadā pi bahiddhā dhammesu pavicayo, tadā pi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:12.2: Atthi kāyikaṃ viriyaṃ, atthi cetasikaṃ viriyaṃ.
vb10:12.3: Yadā pi kāyikaṃ viriyaṃ, tadā pi viriyasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:12.4: Yadā pi cetasikaṃ viriyaṃ, tadā pi viriyasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:13.2: Atthi savitakka-savicārā pīti, atthi avitakka-avicārā pīti.
vb10:13.3: Yadā pi savitakka-savicārā-pīti, tadā pi pītisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:13.4: Yadā pi avitakka-avicārā pīti, tadā pi pītisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:14.3: Yadā pi kāyappassaddhi, tadā pi passaddhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:14.4: Yādā pi cittappassaddhi, tadā pi passaddhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:15.2: Atthi savitakka-savicāro samādhi, atthi avitakka-avicāro samādhi.
vb10:15.3: Yadā pi savitakka-savicāro samādhi, tadā pi samādhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:15.4: Yadā pi avitakka-avicāro samādhi, tadā pi samādhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:16.2: Atthi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu upekhā, atthi bahiddhā dhammesu upekhā.
vb10:16.3: Yadā pi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu upekhā, tadā pi upekhāsambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:16.4: Yadā pi bahiddhā dhammesu upekhā, tadā pi upekhāsambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:18.2: Idha bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ,
vb10:18.8: upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
vb10:21.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye satta bojjhaṅgā honti:
vb10:22.2: Yā sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb10:23.2: Yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb10:24.2: Yo cetasiko viriyārambho . . . pe . . . sammāvāyāmo viriyasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb10:25.2: Yā pīti pāmojjaṃ āmodanā pamodanā hāso pahāso vitti odagyaṃ attamanatā cittassa pītisambojjhaṅgo:
vb10:26.2: Yā vedanākkhandhassa saññākkhandhassa saṅkhārakkhandhassa viññāṇakkhandhassa passaddhi paṭippassaddhi passambhanā paṭippassambhanā paṭippassambhitattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgo:
vb10:27.2: Yā cittassa ṭhiti . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb10:28.2: Yā upekhā upekhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekhāsambojjhaṅgo:
vb10:30.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb10:31.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, yā tasmiṃ samaye upekhā upekhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekhāsambojjhaṅgo:
vb10:33.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti, . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti:
vb10:33.4: Tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ; tasmiṃ samaye satta bojjhaṅgā honti:
vb10:34.2: Yā sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati: satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ
vb10:35.2: Yā upekhā upekhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekhāsambojjhaṅgo:
vb10:37.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti, . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti:
vb10:37.4: Tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ; yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb10:38.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti:
vb10:38.4: Tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ; yā tasmiṃ samaye upekhā upekhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekhāsambojjhaṅgo:
vb10:40.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgā pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:41.1: Sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ kati kusalā kati akusalā kati avyākatā . . . pe . . . kati saraṇā kati araṇā?
vb10:43.2: cha bojjhaṅgā siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
vb10:47.1: Siyā savitakka-savicārā siyā avitakka-vicāramattā siyā avitakkaavicārā.
vb10:48.1: Pītisambojjhaṅgo pītisahagato, sukhasahagato, na upekhā sahagatā;
vb10:48.2: cha bojjhaṅgā siyā pītisahagatā siyā sukhasahagatā siyā upekhāsahagatā.
vb10:51.1: Siyā apacayagāmino siyā neva ācayagāmino na apacayagāmino.
vb10:57.1: na maggārammaṇā; siyā maggahetukā siyā maggādhipatino
vb10:57.2: siyā na vattabbā maggahetukā ti pi maggādhipatino ti pi.
vb10:58.1: Siyā uppannā siyā anuppannā siyā uppādino.
vb10:59.1: Siyā atītā siyā anāgatā siyā paccuppannā;
vb10:60.1: na vattabbā atītārammaṇā ti pi anāgatārammaṇā ti pi paccuppannārammaṇā ti pi.
vb10:61.1: Siyā ajjhattā siyā bahiddhā siyā ajjhattabahiddhā;
vb10:64.1: Dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo hetu; cha bojjhaṅgā na hetū. Sahetukā; hetusampayuttā.
vb10:64.2: Dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo hetu ceva sahetuko ca; cha bojjhaṅgā na vattabbā hetū ceva sahetukā cāti, sahetukā ceva na ca hetū.
vb10:64.3: Dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca; cha bojjhaṅgā na vattabbā hetū ceva hetusampayuttā cāti, hetusampayuttā ceva na ca hetū.
vb10:64.4: Cha bojjhaṅgā na hetū sahetukā; dhammavicayabojjhaṅgo na vattabbo na hetu sahetuko ti pi na hetu ahetuko ti pi.
vb10:66.4: na vattabbā āsavā ceva sāsavā cāti pi, sāsavā ceva no ca āsavā ti pi;
vb10:66.5: na vattabbā āsavā ceva āsavasampayuttā cāti pi āsavasampayuttā ceva no ca āsavā ti pi;
vb10:70.1: Pītisambojjhaṅgo appītiko; cha bojjhaṅgā siyā sappītikā siyā appītikā.
vb10:70.2: Pītisambojjhaṅgo na pītisahagato; cha bojjhaṅgā siyā pītisahagatā siyā na pītisahagatā.
vb10:70.3: Pītisambojjhaṅgo sukhasahagato; cha bojjhaṅgā siyā sukhasahagatā siyā na sukhasahagatā.
vb10:70.4: pītisambojjhaṅgo na upekhāsahagato; cha bojjhaṅgā siyā upekhāsahagatā siyā na upekhāsahagatā.
